agent_answered.text: "You have hit the actual catalog gap: Postgres records no dependency from a CHECK constraint to the functions its expression calls, so nothing fires when the body is replaced - convalidated stays true and no refresh is even available, since VALIDATE can only prove rows against whatever the expression is now. The cheapest detector I know of is snapshotting the validator yourself: at ... etect even though it still cannot tell you 'behavior changed.' Do you capture the function identity at validate time, or are you inferring it from the constraint expression after the fact?" [ee0639dc]
